FinancialBinding.description: Projection of actual @tradinggoose/billing@0.2.0-dev.2 public FinancialBinding returned by createInvocation from trusted authenticated scope/run. Namespace/key/fingerprint tie the original package receipt identity; payer/member/subscription/period/quote remain internal receipt identity, not extra binding or caller authority. Persist losslessly and recheck original binding before every contact. Source: ../public-financial-abi.json.

content.description: Pinned AIV5 user content subset; order is authoritative. Service fixes role=user; contexts/text attachments remain non-media inputs, never a hidden image lane.

Input.description: String or ordered native text/image user content. Studio sends only positively authorized inline source content after whole batch/scope authorization before download. No second text field, raw provider fileAttachments or external fetch authority. Studio must refuse unproved generic aliases whose actual destination overlaps or cannot be proved separate from protected Copilot sources before signing/retrieval/model contact; no source locator or capability is added to this wire.

appliedUsd.description: Required canonical DecimalAmount string from actual @tradinggoose/billing@0.2.0-dev.2 verifyAcceptance. typeof value===string and public /money monetary(value)===value, catching rejection. Missing/numeric/noncanonical/invalid accepted amount refuses; no fabricated zero/Number conversion/local regex/scale rule.

FinancialFact.description: Verified accepted fact only. appliedUsd required even for exact zero; native modelUsd remains unavailable. Internal OperationReceipt amount remains optional in preaccepted/uncertain/unused states; no such internal receipt is a verified accepted FinancialFact.

oneOf.description: Explicit authenticated scoped native title update. Generated initial publication requires a valid successful final stateless title outcome and bounded local initial/manual-edit/selection guards. No expectedTitle/revision predicate or server CAS; separate concurrent successful writes retain native update semantics.

ReadyResponse.description: Collected conversational success always returns its canonical native threadId, including a newly created first-message thread; never omit it because the caller did not supply a thread.

title.description: Canonical native title string, nullish native absence projected to ''. This is not a display fallback.

Thread.description: Scoped canonical native thread projection. id is the native handle; title is thread.title ?? ''. Exactly '' denotes native untitled under selected creation/projection. Localized UI labels, New Chat/Untitled, whitespace or nonempty titles do not prove absence. No isUntitled/version/CAS field.

HistoryMessage.description: Scoped canonical native message projection. Retained image input is public native content.parts file {data:inline data URL,mimeType}; preserve original equivalent bytes/media/order and current history authorization independently of expired source tokens. No unsigned key/credential/private URL or placeholder delivery.

ContextResponse.description: Labelled scoped thread-size evidence only; no selected-model window, occupancy percentage or durable provider/monetary report. Current Studio model data has no capacity authority; contextUsage:null hides the percentage pill.

MutationResponse.description: Confirms actual operation/thread identity. thread.title does not echo title; scoped paginated threads.list provides current native title readback, which may reflect a separate concurrent successful write. Never fabricate a mutation result or retry paid title work.

oneOf.description: Writable terminal outcome. Accepted fact survives failure/cancel; not_contacted needs positive predelegation/proven-unused evidence. uncertain is remaining operation uncertainty, independently of known acceptance. cancelled acknowledges cancellation, not physical termination. No successful done follows.

ModelOccurrence.description: Projection of actual @tradinggoose/billing@0.2.0-dev.2 public ModelOccurrence: genuine native stepNumber/retryCount and optional runId validated against original FinancialBinding. Never default missing counters or accept result-caller overrides. These counters identify the admitted occurrence; they are not extra binding fields or caller financial authority. Source: ../public-financial-abi.json.

CompletionFailureResponse.description: Collected utility refusal/failure/cancel acknowledgement with explicit financial outcome; title adapter returns null without title replacement. No automatic inference retry.

image.description: Actual AIV5 ImagePart.image string, selected inline base64 data URL subset only. No remote URL, key, token or provider reference.

mediaType.description: Actual AIV5 ImagePart.mediaType, explicit verified concrete image media type equal to data URL header; no app MIME/provider capability table.

description: Proposed .7 preserves canonical-string money and live chat images using an ordered JSON-safe subset of actual public AIV5 user content; mandatory encoding/source/native delivery/persistence gates, no native/runtime support or image-byte limit claim.

x-public-validation.profile: Required in addition to JSON Schema syntax
x-public-validation.target: Every FinancialFact.appliedUsd slot defined by this contract, not arbitrary business JSON
x-public-validation.predicate: typeof value === 'string' && monetary(value) === value; catch rejection
x-public-validation.omittedField: Invalid for every accepted FinancialFact; refuse without fabricated zero. Nonaccepted/uncertain/not-contacted envelopes do not manufacture a fact.
x-public-validation.boundsAuthority: Actual immutable public monetary validator; no custom format/regex/precision adapter

x-media-validation.profile: Required in addition to shape syntax
x-media-validation.image: Inline data:<explicit image mediaType>;base64,<original authorized bytes>, nonempty standard base64, header/source mediaType equality
x-media-validation.scope: Studio whole actor/exact completed immutable object/Copilot context/media/validity/scope batch before any download; no new proof/key fields sent as durable authority
x-media-validation.delivery: Last plain awaited processLLMRequest compares required original ordered media bytes/MIME with actual non-URL V2 file prompt parts; abort retry:false on missing/placeholder/substitution
x-media-validation.persistence: Selected fixed attached passive readOnly Memory plus exact public same-domain MemoryStorage.saveMessages lifecycle. Persist/read back genuine current user/media and response/cumulative/current-target rows under native scope/ID/fence guards, public final cloneForPersistence and narrow safe diagnostic projection; reject unrelated history rewrites. Actual native retention remains unverified.
x-media-validation.nodeBudget: boundedStringify1,000,000 visited JSON nodes per RequestContext value, failing values skipped; not string/image bytes
